limits: Hidden-window completion/readback-inclusive measurements; excludes gameplay simulation, extraction and final presentation; no GPU timestamp/FPS claims.
Seven motion pairs; static scenes are one-pair correctness/admission smoke measurements, not repeatability claims.
No-cloud motion median regresses from 5.772 to 7.666 ms; clouds median 9.914 to 10.107 ms. Do not claim uniform speedup.
Original combined-mode and preliminary over-budget runs superseded and excluded.

Native cache integration tested on macOS software/OpenGL/Metal; Linux Vulkan covers shared native device pass changes, not full game cache integration. Windows/D3D12, physical iOS, full compatibility matrix and maintainer gameplay unverified.
